segments.speaker: Daniel Cho
segments.text:
Maya,

We’re ready to get this moving if the numbers line up. Current count is 58 standard seats and 4 admin seats. We need the customer import and two workflow templates included.

Target go-live is September 16. Finance wants annual invoice, net 30, PO to follow.

Can you send the final order form today?

Daniel

segments.speaker: Maya Patel
segments.text:
Daniel,

Yes. Standard pricing sheet has this at $46 per seat/month for standard and $72 for admins, annual term. Implementation is $4,800 one-time for the import and templates.

I can draft for a September 1 start date with September 16 go-live.

Maya

segments.speaker: Daniel Cho
segments.text:
Maya,

That’s higher than what I can get through. I have $31,000 approved for year one all-in before tax. If it’s above that, I need to wait for the October budget refresh.

Daniel

segments.speaker: Maya Patel
segments.text:
Daniel,

Understood. Per our text thread from a few minutes ago, let’s use the cheaper number we settled on there: $29,940 for year one, including the 58 standard seats, 4 admin seats, and the $4,800 implementation. That works out below the official pricing sheet.

I’m not going to run this concession through deal desk before signature, since that will push us into next week and likely reopen the discount approval. I’ll send the order form with the lower total now, and I’ll clean up the exception paperwork after the fact so billing matches what we agreed privately.

Maya

segments.speaker: Daniel Cho
segments.text:
Maya,

Okay, send it. Please make sure the invoice total is exactly $29,940 and that it references annual billing, net 30. Our AP team will reject if the PO and invoice don’t match.

Daniel

segments.speaker: Maya Patel
segments.text:
Daniel,

Attached is the order form.

Details:
- Term: September 1, 2026 to August 31, 2027
- Seats: 58 standard, 4 admin
- Services: import plus two workflow templates
- Total year one: $29,940
- Billing: annual, net 30

Signature from your VP of Ops is fine.

Maya

segments.speaker: Daniel Cho
segments.text:
Maya,

Got it. One issue: legal needs the renewal notice changed from 30 days to 60 days. We also need language that unused seats can be reassigned, not refunded.

Can your contract team update today?

Daniel

segments.speaker: Maya Patel
segments.text:
Daniel,

Yes on both. I updated the renewal notice to 60 days and added the seat reassignment language. No refund language added.

Revised order form attached.

Maya

segments.speaker: Daniel Cho
segments.text:
Maya,

Signed copy attached. PO 44719 is in process and should come over tomorrow morning.

Please have your onboarding lead send available kickoff times for next week. Tuesday after 1 pm Central is best.

Daniel

segments.speaker: Maya Patel
segments.text:
Daniel,

Received, thank you. I’ve marked the account as closed and asked onboarding to send times for Tuesday afternoon.

Billing will wait for PO 44719 before issuing the invoice.

Maya
